LESSON: ISLAM IN KENYA EASTERN KENYA

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Islamic Heritage and Civilisation
Topic 7.1: Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What factors facilitated the spread of Islam in Kenya?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the factors that facilitated the spread of Islam in Kenya
2. explain the effects of the contact between the early Muslims and the natives as a factor of civilisation
3. appreciate the contribution of Islam to the development of culture in Kenya

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
